stories.headline: 'Long Forgotten': Lay preacher delves into biblical topics he says too many churches neglect
stories.summary: When local ministry leader Greg Sutton began examining his personal convictions, an unexpected publishing project took shape. His new work explores scriptural themes that he feels modern congregations frequently overlook. By sharing these reflections, Sutton hopes to encourage fellow believers to deepen their understanding of Scripture and grow more confident in their daily walk of faith.
